capabilities: , Search notes by text in embeds
extras: Pro features require GitHub sponsorship; requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
intentEvidence: Find a review note from text that lives in its Markdown embeds.
problem: Users often need to find specific content that is referenced only through Markdown embeds rather than being directly visible in the note body.
summary: Finds text within Markdown embeds across notes in a selected folder, identifying the containing note and the source of the match.
